mapper.select: select * from tbl_category where parent_seq is null and enabled = 'Y' order by sort_order
select * from tbl_category where parent_seq is not null and enabled = 'Y' order by parent_seq, sort_order
select * from tbl_category where parent_seq is null order by sort_order, category_seq

select c.*, (select count(*) from tbl_talent t where t.category_seq = c.category_seq and t.enabled = 'Y') as talent_count, (select count(*) from tbl_request r where r.category_seq = c.category_seq) as request_count from tbl_category c where c.parent_seq = #{parentSeq} order by c.sort_order, c.category_seq
mapper.insert: insert into tbl_category (category_seq, parent_seq, name, sort_order, enabled) values (seq_category.nextval, #{parentSeq}, #{name}, (select nvl(max(sort_order), 0) + 1 from tbl_category where parent_seq = #{parentSeq}), 'Y')
mapper.update: update tbl_category set sort_order = #{sortOrder} where category_seq = #{categorySeq}
